messages.author: a200b0eb7dbe1ca6
messages.subject: Multivariate package
parts:
Hey all, 

Does anyone know of a package for multivariate modeling (i.e., multiple response variables) where one can specify the error distribution? 

Thanks,
Patrick

messages.author: f8f554f3c8aec296
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Multivariate package
parts:
Hey Patrick, 

I believe MCMCglmm has some ability to do multivar responses, but it's limited (eg https://stat.ethz.ch/pipermail/r-sig-mixed-models/2011q1/015644.html ) so may not fit your needs. 

More generally, you could set up a full Bayesian model in rstan or rjags, but as Jarrod Hadfield cautions in the linked thread, the data requirements may be very high 

- Jaime
